declarations.bodyReview: Actual induction, prefix restriction, terminal-summand cancellation and minimizer comparison. Both hmem and hmin used; neither supplied conclusion nor stronger regularity.

objects_and_spaces.actual_evidence:
theorem lemma_1_2 {X : Type*} (V : Set X) (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (leader : ℕ → X) (T : ℕ)
    (hmem : ∀ n, 0 < n → n ≤ T → leader n ∈ V)
    (hmin : ∀ n, 0 < n → n ≤ T → ∀ u ∈ V,
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, loss t (leader n)) ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, loss t u) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t (leader (t + 1))) ≤
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t (leader T)

then conclude the displayed sum inequality

truthBoundary: This is an audit, reader and test integration for twelve existing APIs, not twelve new production or printed theorems. Lemma 1.2 keeps supplied feasible minimizers for every positive prefix; its arbitrary carrier and empty-horizon extension are explicit. Generic L2 identities and supplied-independence consumers remain distinct from actual strict-past independence producers. Legacy indexed mean/history APIs retain pointwise target support for every time and outcome. The separate source_mean_optimal API concerns one measurable variable and every outcome, with no time quantifier; its optimum compares all real constants. The history loss bound retains policy feasibility on every real history tuple, including illegal histories, and uses the current-round variance without a same-law premise. Finite identities, nonnegativity and positive-horizon scalar normalization do not claim convergence. Later accepted almost-sure/legal-history and asymptotic results remain separate. General strategy representation, completed-information and AE-factorization obligations, the unknown mandatory proof-leaf total, Chapter 1 and whole-book completion remain outside this audit. Eight historical missing-byte literal uses across three digests, with one overlapping structured use, retain their original owners and OPEN status. Full purification and Exposition Seal remain pending.
